description: 鉄道時系列データ [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in National Land Numerical Information (国土数値情報) download site of MLIT, Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 2025年（令和7年）12月31日から1950年（昭和25年）1月1日までに運行していた全国の旅客鉄道・軌道の路線や駅の開業・廃止情報として、事業者（新幹線、JR在来線、公営鉄道、民営鉄道、第三セクター）、 事業者名、路線名、運営会社等などの変遷情報を路線形状（線）、駅位置（点）ごとに時系列的に整備したものです（貨物駅と貨物路線は除く）... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp, geojson. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is non-commercial use only under the download site terms. Caveats: this record was written from the product page on the download site (title, description where given, licence, formats and dates), so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information.
